metadata.title: A cut-and-project set which is not bi-Lipschitz equivalent to a lattice
metadata.abstract: We construct a cut-and-project set in a totally irrational plane in $\mathbb{R}^3$, with a compact window which is the closure of its interior and has countable boundary, which is not bi-Lipschitz equivalent to a lattice. This answers a question of Burago and Kleiner about cut-and-project sets, and shows in particular that the hypothesis of boundary measure zero is not enough to guarantee bi-Lipschitz equivalence to a lattice. Since our set has uniform density, it also shows that a non-rectifiable Delone set need not encode a non-realisable density, answering a question of Bhat and Dymond.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在 R³ 中全无理平面上构造具有紧窗口的 cut-and-project 集，窗口为其内部闭包且边界可数，但该 Delone 集不与格双 Lipschitz 等价。
analysis.breakthrough: 说明窗口边界零测仍不足以保证格等价，并以均匀密度例子区分不可整直性与不可实现密度。
analysis.limitations: 反例不否定所有更规则窗口的正面结果；密度均匀也不等于几何上格状。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
